privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Grace for Every Day
privacy.grace_for_every_day_4: Grace for Every Day ("we", "our", "the app") is committed to protecting your privacy.
privacy.the_app_does_not_6: The app does not collect, store, or share any personal data. We do not require account creation or login. No analytics, tracking, or advertising SDKs are included.
privacy.the_app_displays_content_8: The app displays content from graceforevery.day. When you use the app, your device connects to our web server to load devotional content. Standard web server logs (IP address, timestamp) may be recorded for security purposes and are automatically deleted after 30 days.
privacy.the_app_does_not_10: The app does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.
privacy.the_app_is_suitable_12: The app is suitable for all ages and does not knowingly collect information from children.
privacy.we_may_update_this_14: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.
privacy.questions_about_this_policy_16: Questions about this policy? Email us at journey@azurenexus.com
